about_preview.title: A Boy's Dream, Forged with Grown-Up Craft.
about_preview.p1: Kagami Industrial is a one-of-a-kind enterprise that fuses the engineering prowess cultivated in industrial robotics and construction machinery with an insatiable passion for toys and entertainment.
about_preview.p2: Upon the solid industrial foundation built by the founding generation, second-generation CEO Hayato Kagami raised a bold new vision — steering the company with the resolve to turn what he loves into his life's work.

business_preview.title: Business Domains
business_preview.heavy_text: Development and manufacture of industrial robots and construction machinery. Driving global infrastructure projects including our Indonesia branch.
business_preview.hobby_text: Planning and development of precision die-cast cars, plastic model kits, and trading card games (TCG).
business_preview.ent_text: Advancing next-generation virtual entertainment through a strategic PR partnership with ANYCOLOR Inc.

philosophy.quote_1: Those who cannot be serious about play
philosophy.body_1: We believe that the essence of "making things" lies in the act of enjoying them.
philosophy.body_2: Whether a towering industrial robot or a miniature car in your palm,
philosophy.body_3: the passion poured into each is without hierarchy.
philosophy.body_4: Kagami Industrial walks alongside every creator.

recruit_cta.title: Let's Shape Our Passion Together.
recruit_cta.body: At Kagami Industrial, we are seeking passionate colleagues to thrive across fields spanning heavy industry, hobbies, and entertainment. Duelists, aspiring vocalists, and those who can rediscover their inner child in the toy aisle — all are welcome.

footer.disclaimer: [Disclaimer] This site is an unofficial fan site created by fans of Virtual Liver "Hayato Kagami" (ANYCOLOR Inc.). It has no affiliation with any real individuals, organizations, or companies. Content includes fiction based on official streams and wiki information.

about_page.ceo_quote: Those who cannot be serious about play shall never do great work.
about_page.ceo_p_founding: Kagami Industrial was founded by my father. Industrial robots, materials, heavy machinery — true to the name "Industrial," my father faced "steel" head-on at the forefront of Japanese manufacturing. Having grown up watching his back, this company is not merely a business to me, but the pride of our family.
about_page.ceo_p_turning:
The turning point came at a corporate event. The precision die-cast miniature cars we produced as novelties for dealers and shareholders attracted a level of passionate response far beyond our expectations. The crowd was captivated by the craftsmanship — a product of our heavy industry precision machining — and demand for mass production flooded in.

As a result, we launched the Hobby Division, and as the resident hobby enthusiast, I took charge. The moment "what I love" became my work.
about_page.ceo_p_three:
As CEO — I hold sincerity and decorum dear. I strive to engage every person with respect and to make broad-minded decisions.

As a musician — I carry a deep passion for singing and sound. Once I grip the microphone, the gentle voice disappears. The sheer sonic force behind the shouts woven into my powerful singing voice is something to behold.

As a boy — Faced with an interesting toy, game, big mech, or formidable opponent, I revert instantly to a grade-school boy. Pursuing "cool" with abandon, fiercely loyal to bonds and convictions. That boy's heart is my greatest weapon.
about_page.ceo_p_challenge:
Our PR partnership with ANYCOLOR Inc. began when I, the CEO himself, personally submitted an audition to Nijisanji's standing recruitment. It was an unprecedented PR strategy — the President and CEO debuting as a Virtual Liver to promote our own products. Guided by the core principle of "entertaining our audience," we continue to pursue entertainment as a true art form.

Giants of steel, miniature cars in your palm. All passions are equal.

Under this conviction, I intend to walk forward together with all of our shareholders.
about_page.ceo_draft_note: * This text is a draft composed by the fan PR team based on public streams. It does not record actual statements by the President.

business_page.heavy_body: Our founding business — the development and manufacture of industrial robots and construction machinery. Building upon the technological base established by our founding president, we have expanded into infrastructure development including tunnel excavation. We also actively participate in global infrastructure projects through our Indonesian branch.
business_page.heavy_ach_1: Infrastructure development projects through the Indonesia branch
business_page.heavy_ach_2: Large-scale excavation projects including tunnel construction
business_page.hobby_body: A division established simultaneously with the inauguration of President Hayato Kagami. Leveraging precision machining technology cultivated in heavy industry, we plan, develop, and market high-quality hobby products.
business_page.hobby_prod_1: Precision die-cast cars (commercialised from shareholder novelties)
business_page.group_intro:
Kagami Industrial is a group enterprise with operations spanning diverse fields.
Click each company name to view details.
business_page.resort_body: A resort development enterprise themed on "dialogue with nature." We are pushing forward construction of resort facilities and golf courses amid breathtaking natural scenery. In the "Forest" area in particular, extensive careful discussions with local residents (including vigorous physical negotiations) have been held before proceeding with development.
business_page.resort_note: * Local negotiations are always conducted in good faith. We can assure you that the safety of our negotiators is fully secured.
business_page.insurance_body: An insurance company boasting industry-leading responsiveness — a reputation that began with an unprecedented claim settlement: full restoration of all items lost when a policyholder's home was bombed. Our product lineup includes the industry-first "Weakness Insurance" and many other policies that rival companies find difficult to handle.
business_page.insurance_note: * Weakness Insurance offers plans optimally tailored to your specific weakness attribute.
business_page.water_body: The public infrastructure division responsible for the laying and management of water and sewage systems. Our facilities boast exceptional durability, reliably supporting the lifelines of local communities.
business_page.water_note: * While some experts have described our water infrastructure as a "Type-A weapon of mass destruction" or "a spark for war," these are purely figurative expressions. Our waterworks facilities fully comply with all applicable safety standards.
business_page.realestate_body: Specialists in properties with unique conditions. We address niche requests that conventional real estate agencies struggle to accommodate — such as "living room 20+ tatami mats, garden, pet-friendly, near water source, iron ore within 3 minutes on foot."
business_page.realestate_note: * We also offer services through our subsidiary Kagami Home Consulting, specialising in stigmatised properties. Our housing concierge will propose the optimal property for you.
business_page.ceremony_body: Under General Manager Hayato Kagami, we deliver "moving productions" that bring colour to life's final chapter. With a commitment to moving every guest, we provide comprehensive production of ceremonies that leave a lasting impression in the heart.
business_page.ceremony_note: * The General Manager may personally handle narration duties. Please be advised regarding the sound pressure in such cases.
business_page.heavy_co_body: A subsidiary rooted in the Heavy Industry Division of Kagami Industrial. The cornerstone of our industrial robot and construction machinery manufacturing.
business_page.holdings_body: Serves as the holding company for the entire group while also operating convenience stores. Particular emphasis is placed on late-night operations.
business_page.holdings_note: * Special allowances are provided to employees on night shifts.
business_page.electric_body: The group's electrical engineering subsidiary. Details are undisclosed, but duties primarily involve the construction and management of electrical facilities in infrastructure development.
business_page.electric_note: * New business ventures are currently in planning.
business_page.home_consult_body: A real estate consulting firm specialising in stigmatised properties. As your "housing concierge," we rediscover the value in properties with unique circumstances and propose the ideal plan for you. President Hayato Kagami himself may conduct on-site inspections.
business_page.home_consult_note: * Even "properties with a past" come with peace-of-mind guarantees. Feel free to consult us.

history_page.era_founding_body: Founded by Hayato Kagami's father under the name "Kagami Industrial." True to the "Industrial" name, production of industrial robots, materials, and heavy machinery begins immediately. The foundation is laid for Kagami's contribution to Japan's heavy industry development.
history_page.era_diecast_title: Die-Cast Miniature Cars Become a Social Phenomenon
history_page.era_diecast_body: Precision die-cast miniature cars produced as novelties for dealers and shareholders at a corporate event ignite passionate demand far beyond expectations. The result: the establishment of the Hobby Division. As the resident hobby enthusiast, Hayato Kagami takes charge of the new division.
history_page.era_ceo_title: Hayato Kagami Inaugurated as President & CEO
history_page.era_ceo_body: Hayato Kagami is inaugurated as President and CEO. Simultaneously, the "Hobby & Entertainment Division" is established. The corporate slogan "A Boy's Dream, Forged with Grown-Up Craft" is officially adopted. Entry into the TCG and plastic model kit businesses follows.
history_page.era_anycolor_title: PR Partnership with ANYCOLOR Inc. Established
history_page.era_anycolor_body: To promote company products, President Hayato Kagami personally submits an application to Nijisanji's standing audition. A PR partnership is established with ANYCOLOR Inc., and he makes his debut as a Virtual Liver. His very first stream features an original song, stunning audiences with his remarkable musicality.
history_page.era_smc_body: Technical advisory contracts are signed with Fuyuki Hakase, an expert in Science, and Rena Yomimiya, an expert in Magic. The joint research institute "SMC Lab" — a tripartite academia-industry-magic collaboration — is established and begins work on next-generation power source development.
history_page.era_3d_body: A large-scale presentation leveraging cutting-edge 3D avatar technology is held. A historic achievement is reached: 130,000 concurrent shareholders connected. The event receives high praise from both the industrial and entertainment sectors.
history_page.era_wixoss_title: Company Headquarters Immortalised as a WIXOSS Card
history_page.era_wixoss_body: In a collaboration with TCG "WIXOSS," the Kagami Industrial headquarters building is immortalised as a card. Notably, the building received its card before the President himself — a rare and remarkable turn of events.
history_page.era_school_title: Educational Institution "Kagami Technical High School" Established
history_page.era_school_body: As part of CSR activities, "Kagami Technical High School" is established. Dedicated to youth development through sports promotion — particularly strong support for the baseball club — the school has produced many legendary matches at the annual Koshien tournament, earning broad social acclaim.
history_page.era_present_body: Kagami Industrial continues to forge ahead: expanding overseas infrastructure projects (including tunnel excavation) through the Indonesian branch; appearing in official Duel Masters Plays broadcasts; expanding group subsidiaries; and advancing research and development on next-generation power sources.

technology_page.smc_body: SMC Lab is the joint research institute of Kagami Industrial, established in August 2019. With Fuyuki Hakase as Science Advisor and Rena Yomimiya as Magic Advisor, we drive innovative research and development that transcends the conventional boundaries of science and technology.
technology_page.research1_title: Magic-Technology Fusion: Next-Generation Power Source Development
technology_page.research1_body: Research into an entirely new energy source that transcends the boundary between science and magic. By integrating the physics-based approach of Science Advisor Hakase with the arcane insights of Magic Advisor Yomimiya, we aim to realise innovative technology surpassing existing power sources.
technology_page.research2_title: Caffeine Intake & Workplace Efficiency: Field Trial
technology_page.research2_body: A large-scale field trial conducted with SMC Lab researchers. Quantitative analysis of the impact on research output from optimal caffeine dosage, timing, and temperature combinations. To date, a correlation between coffee consumption and academic paper writing speed has been confirmed.
technology_page.research3_body: Research into remote presence technology leveraging 3D model technology. The large-scale 2020 presentation achieved 130,000 concurrent connections. We aim to establish new communication methods that fuse reality and the virtual world.
technology_page.research4_body: Simulation-based optimisation of card balance in trading card games. We research methods to maintain a healthy metagame environment across diverse titles including Duel Masters Plays, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and MTG. Regular field verification sessions are held in which the President himself participates as a test player.

sustainability_page.edu_body: Kagami Industrial has established and operates the educational institution "Kagami Technical High School" as part of its CSR activities. Guided by the philosophy of fostering the spirit of manufacturing and healthy youth development through sports, we support the growth of the next generation.
sustainability_page.edu_baseball_body: Investing in facilities and coaching infrastructure with the goal of competing at the annual Koshien tournament. The team has a proven track record of producing legendary matches.
sustainability_page.edu_curriculum_body: Hands-on technical education preparing students for the frontlines of heavy industry and hobby manufacturing. The President himself has delivered special lectures.
sustainability_page.community1_body: Through large-scale land-clearing activities in virtual spaces, we contribute to the development and maintenance of the digital environment. We promote the construction of safe and comfortable virtual communities.
sustainability_page.community2_body: We strive to ensure the safety of local residents through public safety activities such as monster spawn elimination. The President himself leads the charge in making dangerous areas safe.
sustainability_page.community3_body: Through Kagami Waterworks and our entire group, we contribute to securing the lifelines of local communities through water and sewage infrastructure development.
sustainability_page.community4_body: The Kagami Group as a whole actively promotes the recycling of plastic resources. When President Hayato Kagami visited the responsible facility, he personally crushed 20 plastic bottles in 30 seconds by hand, showcasing Kagami Industrial's commitment to sustainability.
sustainability_page.community4_body2: The members of ROF-MAO who witnessed the President's feat praised it with "He's a gorilla..." — leading this initiative to be nicknamed the "Smash & Destroy Gorilla solution" — SDGs.
sustainability_page.commitment_body: Kagami Industrial is committed to solving social issues through its business activities. Providing educational opportunities, environmentally conscious development, and coexistence with local communities — all of these are part of our "manufacturing." We believe that "a society where everyone can be serious about play" is a sustainable society.

recruit_page.ceo_quote:
We are looking for companions to build the future together.
Steel, toys, entertainment —
All "genuine passion" is welcome.
recruit_page.duelist_body: Card game experience strongly preferred. We welcome Duel Masters players (those who can speak to Bolbalzak Ex), Yu-Gi-Oh! fans (devotees of Dark-attribute Dragons), and MTG players (drawn to Grixis colours). Duel Masters Plays experience is a major plus.
recruit_page.singer_body: Those with a burning passion for singing. You may find yourself shining at company karaoke events — or even landing a duet with the President. Those confident in their vocal power are especially welcome.
recruit_page.boyish_body: Those who can revert to childhood at the toy aisle. Genobureikaa, Ex-S Gundam, Tieren, Mazinkaiser — if your eyes light up at the word "cool," you are exactly who we are looking for. Prior plastic model assembly experience is a significant advantage.
recruit_page.spring_sub: Held annually in the company garden
recruit_page.fac1: ✓ State-of-the-art soundproofed studio (adjacent to the President's office)
recruit_page.fac6: ✓ Employee discount at Kagami Resort facilities

ir_page.diecast_body:
An exclusive precision die-cast car is delivered to shareholders every year. Manufactured with the precision machining technology of our Heavy Industry Division, it is a collector's treasure.

※ The legendary novelty at the very origin of our company — the spark that ignited the Hobby Division.
ir_page.agm_body: Shareholders attending the annual general meeting receive an exclusive goods set. Past examples include limited TCG cards and plastic model instruction booklets personally signed by the President.
ir_page.ceo_quote: To our shareholders. Your support is the greatest asset of Kagami Industrial.
ir_page.vision_body: Kagami Industrial aims to achieve both a stable earnings base and growth drivers through dual-axis management of "Heavy Industry" and "Entertainment." Leveraging the stable cash flow generated by our existing heavy industry division, we will continue active investment into the Hobby & Entertainment business.
ir_page.strat1: Expansion of infrastructure business in the Asian market, centred on the Indonesian branch
ir_page.strat2: Full-scale expansion of the TCG business and extension into digital content
ir_page.strat3: Commercialisation of SMC Lab research outcomes (next-generation power sources)
ir_page.strat4: Establishing first-mover advantage in virtual entertainment
ir_page.returns_body: We position shareholder returns as one of the most critical priorities of our management. In addition to dividends, we continue to strengthen our relationship with shareholders through enriched shareholder perks (exclusive die-cast cars, etc.) and the "entertainmentisation" of our annual general meeting.
